intent: Angular courier: direct purposeful strikes, a compact guard, asymmetric counterbalance and fast readable recovery. Scarf and crest are ornaments, never contact limbs.

timing_contract.authority: Runtime state_frame, hitlag and after_step action/variant export; no combat values originate in this file.
timing_contract.anticipation_fraction: Authored fraction of available inactive startup, not a measured reference-game ratio. If no inactive sample exists, apply contact immediately. Never add a frame.
timing_contract.active: Contact pose takes precedence over idle blending. Solve the named contact piece in world space after body and facing transforms, against the existing hit region.
timing_contract.recovery: Begins after the real last active tick; honor hitlag freezes, landing transitions and any real late-active interval.
timing_contract.variants: Cover the full exported action/variant set, including charged_max and jab2 after_jab1_hit; use both facings.

geometry_contract.units: Existing world units; no scaling, bone-length changes or combat-data edits.
geometry_contract.contact: Measure transformed piece geometry against runtime geometry; report signed gap/intersection and the actual contact piece. If unreachable, report the constraint rather than moving the hitbox.
geometry_contract.special_cases: Projectile emission, radial effects and throw release use their real runtime events; a missing melee hitbox is not an authoring error.
geometry_contract.extras: Apply existing closed lag algorithm after the combat pose, on extra bones only.

reference_review.method: Browser animation inspection of grounded jab, tilt, strong-attack, projectile, dash-special and radial-effect examples. Used only for windup/contact/recovery readability; no values or assets copied.
Read in browser after direct fetch returned 403. Distinguishes startup conventions and active/endlag; OVERFRAME export remains authoritative.

Browser imagery and descriptions inspected across normal moves, strong attacks, all five aerials, four specials and four throws. Original Kestrel directions preserve its own runtime mechanics; see the action-by-action reference study.

reference_audit_status: Pose-family study completed for all 22 actions; see kestrel-reference-study.md. This is not an exact per-frame reconstruction of the reference games. Implementation and game3d review remain pending.

actions.arc: From the compact forward guard straight out and back along the same short line.
actions.torso: Lean through the chest only enough to place the fist in the measured contact region.
actions.other_hand: Left fist stays beside the upper chest, below the face.
actions.recovery: Immediate contact is permitted: this runtime action has no sampled inactive after_step tick. Never delay its hit.

actions.arc: Left hand crosses forward on a shallow rising line as the right hand retracts.
actions.torso: Counter-rotate the chest from jab one, keeping the crest readable.
actions.other_hand: Right hand returns to guard without hiding the left fist.
actions.recovery: Return both hands by separate paths; respect hitlag and the real jab-chain state.

actions.arc: Lift the right knee, extend the sole forward at the runtime hitbox height, then fold the knee back.
actions.torso: Counterbalance behind the kick; solve the full hip-knee-ankle chain against contact geometry.
actions.other_hand: Both fists frame the chest, with the rear elbow visibly separated.
actions.recovery: Retract the shin before lowering the foot; no second unearned extension after the active interval.

actions.arc: Coil the right fist close to the waist, then cut upward on the forward side of the head.
actions.torso: Uncoil upward without stretching bone lengths or dragging the root off its existing transform.
actions.other_hand: Left palm guards the chest rather than following the uppercut.
actions.recovery: Lower through the outside of the guard; avoid a second overhead strike silhouette.

actions.arc: Fold the support knee and skim the right sole forward through the low contact region.
actions.torso: Low diagonal from crest to support hip; head remains clear of the knee.
actions.other_hand: Near hand guards the chin; far hand extends back as a counterweight.
actions.recovery: Fold the striking knee, then rise; respect existing ground support.

actions.arc: Draw the right palm near the rear shoulder, then drive it on a direct forward line through the measured contact region.
actions.torso: Chest and hips unfold into one forward diagonal; the visible body mass supports the palm.
actions.other_hand: Left hand pulls to the ribs and stays separated from the contact arm.
actions.recovery: Recover through the shoulder and bent elbow, without holding a second active-looking thrust. Charging holds the anticipation pose.

actions.arc: Compress the right arm at the chest then thrust upward, palm leading above the crest.
actions.torso: Rise from a compact knee bend into an upward torso line.
actions.other_hand: Left hand remains lower, framing the abdomen and making the contact hand unambiguous.
actions.recovery: Keep the directed palm through the real clean and late active windows, then lower through the outside.

actions.arc: Extend a low right heel from a tightly folded knee into a forward sweep.
actions.torso: Sit the hips over the support leg; preserve a readable gap between the arms and torso.
actions.other_hand: Front hand guards high and the rear hand counterbalances behind.
actions.recovery: Gather the extended leg beneath the body. Do not invent a rear damaging sweep when the runtime has no rear hitbox.

actions.arc: Drive the bent right forearm ahead of the chest, keeping the leading hand on the contact side.
actions.torso: Compact running diagonal; motion comes from the existing simulation displacement.
actions.other_hand: Left arm streams behind the torso with its elbow separated from the scarf.
actions.recovery: Unfold into the recovery stance without adding visual root travel that disagrees with the fighter position.

actions.arc: Snap the right foot forward while the left knee folds back, then gather both legs.
actions.torso: Tilt the torso opposite the right leg to create a single clear diagonal.
actions.other_hand: Hands spread at different heights and stay behind the leading sole.
actions.recovery: Hold a readable extended sole through all real late-active ticks; gather only after the active interval.

actions.arc: Fold the right knee beneath the chest, then push the sole forward and slightly up to the actual contact region.
actions.torso: Counterlean with the chest while keeping the face directed toward the strike.
actions.other_hand: Left hand guards near the face, right hand stays low and behind the knee.
actions.recovery: Retract the knee before dropping the foot; avoid raising it farther only after the hitbox disappears.

actions.arc: Look back, coil the left knee, then extend the heel behind the hips toward the rear hitbox.
actions.torso: Incline the chest forward to balance the rearward strike, without changing facing in simulation.
actions.other_hand: Near hand stays in front of the chest; far hand opens downward.
actions.recovery: Fold the rear knee and recover the torso without a second kick.

actions.arc: Tuck the right knee close then extend the foot upward into the overhead contact region.
actions.torso: Recline enough to clear the leg from the crest silhouette; keep the other knee bent.
actions.other_hand: Hands remain below the chest and at different depths.
actions.recovery: Fold the knee first; untuck the torso only after the active window.

actions.arc: Tuck the right heel beneath the hips, then drive it down and slightly forward into the downward hitbox.
actions.torso: Upright compact torso with a small counterlean; no root plunge beyond the simulation.
actions.other_hand: One hand guards the chest and the other opens backward to reveal the leg.
actions.recovery: Retract through the knee after the last active tick; do not turn the noncontact leg into a second strike.

actions.arc: Gather the right palm to the sternum, then extend it toward the runtime projectile emission line.
actions.torso: Face forward with a small recoil confined to the pose.
actions.other_hand: Left hand braces the upper chest, below the emission line.
actions.recovery: Release is evidenced by the real projectile spawn. Do not draw or require a fictitious melee hitbox, or chase the moving projectile with the hand.

actions.arc: Gather the right arm at the chest and lead the ascent with the palm through the upper contact region.
actions.torso: Long upward diagonal following the existing launch trajectory; knees trail at different heights.
actions.other_hand: Left hand stays near the ribs, separated from the scarf.
actions.recovery: Transition through the existing recovery state. Do not introduce extra flight or drift.

actions.arc: Coil the right elbow back then extend the palm toward the side-special contact region.
actions.torso: Low forward diagonal with the head above the leading forearm.
actions.other_hand: Left hand trails behind the hip rather than overlapping the lead arm.
actions.recovery: Use the existing displacement and active duration, then recover through a bent elbow.

actions.arc: Open the elbows from a compact guard into a short symmetric pulse around the chest.
actions.torso: Center the body in the actual radial effect; keep crest and scarf outlines unobscured.
actions.other_hand: Both hands frame the pulse at different depths; neither pretends to define its whole radius.
actions.recovery: Zero startup means immediate visual response. Align the real radial effect with its runtime origin; do not force a hand to its boundary.

actions.arc: Keep the held target visibly connected to the forward hands, then open the right palm toward the release direction.
actions.torso: Transfer the chest forward during release while the support foot stays coherent.
actions.other_hand: Left hand guides the hold, then withdraws toward the chest.
actions.recovery: Capture the actual grab/release event and victim. Do not fabricate an ordinary hitbox if the throw uses a direct release event.

actions.arc: Guide the held target across the body and open the left hand backward at release.
actions.torso: Twist the chest and glance back; use the actual runtime facing and victim position.
actions.other_hand: Right hand guides the crossing target, then opens away from the release line.
actions.recovery: Recover from the twist without visually teleporting the held fighter or inventing a second strike.

actions.arc: Lift the held target with both hands, right palm leading the upward release.
actions.torso: Extend upward from a compact bend, with head offset enough to keep the hands visible.
actions.other_hand: Left hand supports below the right and opens away at release.
actions.recovery: Lower the hands outside the crest; evidence must show the real release event and target.

actions.arc: Guide the held target downward in front, right hand finishing above the release point.
actions.torso: Fold at hips and knees toward the actual target position, without sinking the feet.
actions.other_hand: Left hand releases early and returns beside the chest.
actions.recovery: Rise only after the actual release; avoid a false ground impact when the runtime does not create one.
